title: tau completions install --json output
description: Schema for the single JSON object `tau completions install [--json]` prints on stdout after installing (or previewing with --dry-run) the generated shell completions. The object carries the same status/shells payload the `tau setup` completions step emits inside its {"step":"completions",...} event, wrapped in an ok/version/done envelope. The process exit code mirrors ok: 0 on success or a shell-detection skip, 1 when an install failed. New keys may be added (additive); existing keys keep their names and types.

ok.description: true unless an install failed. A detection skip (no --shell and an undetectable $SHELL) is reported as status "skipped" with ok true — it is not a failure.

status.description: "installed" covers fresh installs and already-current installs alike; "would_install" under --dry-run (any shell has a pending change); "skipped" when no shell could be detected; "failed" when an install errored (e.g. HOME unset).

shells.description: One entry per resolved shell, in resolution order; absent on skipped/failed-to-resolve outcomes.

path.description: Installed completion script path; absent on failure.

rc.description: Rc/profile file the autoload hook was appended to (zsh/pwsh only).

rc_status.description: Outcome of the rc-hook append (zsh/pwsh only).

reason.description: Why the install was skipped (e.g. could not detect shell from $SHELL).

hint.description: Remediation hint on skipped installs (re-run with --shell ...).

message.description: Failure detail; emitted with status "failed" before shell resolution.

version.description: The tau version that produced this result (e.g. "0.4.0").

done.description: Terminal marker — always true on the result object.
